title: ExecuteMissionPlan
description:
This message is used to begin execution of a mission with the given Mission ID. 
                    Executing a currently paused mission plan will cause execution of that mission plan to start from the beginning
                    again. Executing a different mission while in the paused state will cause the old mission to revert to the LOADED 
                    state before execution of the new mission begins.

RequestID.comment: Locally unique request ID for the request, which the client can use to associated a given response

MissionID.comment: ID of the saved mission to be executed
